claims.text: What the image looks like Distended loop pointing to LUQ → cecal volvulus
claims.quote: Distended loop pointing to LUQ Cecal volvulus

claims.text: Example radiograph: the cecum has twisted around its mesentery, causing a dilated “coffee bean” to project toward the left upper quadrant
claims.quote: In this abdominal radiograph, the cecum has twisted around its mesentery, causing a dilated "coffee bean" to project toward the left upper quadrant.

claims.text: Aspects (abnormal in red) Large bowel: peripheral “picture frame”; haustra do NOT cross the full diameter; dilated > 6 cm (> 9 cm at the cecum)
claims.quote: Large bowel = peripheral 'picture frame', haustra do NOT cross full diameter, dilated >6 cm (>9 cm at cecum).

claims.text: There may be a large gas bubble in the mid-abdomen or left upper quadrant
claims.quote: In cecal volvulus, there may be a large gas bubble in the mid-abdomen or left upper quadrant.

claims.text: Contrast enema: a “bird-beak” deformity at the twist
claims.quote: With both cecal and sigmoid volvulus, a contrast enema shows the site of obstruction by a typical “bird-beak” deformity at the site of the twist; the procedure may actually reduce a sigmoid volvulus.

claims.text: Causes Volvulus is a twisting of the colon around itself, sometimes causing strangulation with ischemia and necrosis
claims.quote: Volvulus is a twisting of the colon around itself, sometimes causing strangulation with ischemia and necrosis.

claims.text: Symptoms Often abrupt onset; continuous pain, sometimes with superimposed waves of colicky pain
claims.quote: Volvulus often has an abrupt onset. Pain is continuous, sometimes with superimposed waves of colicky pain.

claims.text: Treatment and next step Her chart: surgery
Resection and anastomosis of the involved segment, or fixation of the cecum by cecostomy in a frail patient
claims.quote: Treatment of cecal volvulus consists of resection and anastomosis of the involved segment or fixation of the cecum in its normal position by cecostomy in a patient who is frail.

claims.text: Colonoscopic decompression rarely works for a cecal volvulus
claims.quote: colonoscopy can be used to decompress a sigmoid volvulus but rarely works with a cecal volvulus.
